verdict.rationale: Vonage's own docs say you can override automatic server selection and "restrict media to a specific region" through Regional Media Zones, and you can steer server selection with a location IP hint. Both control where media is routed and processed, not where data is stored. Missing for 10: evidence of choosing the storage region for archives and recordings, an explicit data-residency or compliance statement, details of the Regional Media Zones feature (available regions, setup), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: To override this optimization and restrict media to a specific region, see [Regional Media Zones](/video/guides/regional-media-zones).
When you create a session, you can set the IP address that the Vonage video platform will use to select the best server to control the session in its global network.
